violations.text: Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Establishment is to consistently mark tags with the last date of service. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Shell eggs were observed stored above raw shellfish in the walk-in cooler. Food items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment must add an indicating symbol to the menus that disclose which menu items are offered or served undercooked or raw. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Various food items were observed thawing on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Food items were moved into mechanical refrigeration during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #1 and the 2-door reach-in refrigerator. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/08/2026

The prep unit roll covers located in the cookline area were observed detaching and out of alignment and were not in good repair. Refrigerator attachments shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/08/2026

The doors to both of the establishment toilet rooms are not self-closing. Toilet room doors that open to food preparation spaces shall be self-closing to prevent potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #1. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/26/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (dill as garnish for chowder) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Food items were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The can opener was sent to be cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment is to add indicating symbols next to menu items that are served raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled with name of chemical during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Cooked lobster meat and raw sea scallops were observed thawed with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood items packaged in ROP packaging shall be removed from original packaging prior to thawing to allow the reintroduction of oxygen into the food item. Food items were observed at temperatures ranging from 52-58 degrees Fahrenheit and were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils stored between uses shall be stored in of the following manner: on a dry clean surface, in water maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or more, or in water with sufficient flow to flush particulates to the drain. Utensils were cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #1. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/26/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine and quat sanitizing solution for the dishwashers and 3-bay sink in the kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2025
